verses.original: שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בֶן־ דָּוִ֖יד וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֛ק עַל־ מַלְכוּת֑וֹ וַיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ לְמָֽעְלָה׃ וַֽיְגַדְּלֵ֖הוּ
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·mōh ḇen- dā·wîḏ way·yiṯ·ḥaz·zêq ‘al- mal·ḵū·ṯōw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw ‘im·mōw lə·mā·‘ə·lāh way·ḡad·də·lê·hū
verses.literal: Now Solomon son of David established himself securely over his kingdom and the LORD his God was with him and highly exalted him

verses.original: שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל לְשָׂרֵי֩ הָאֲלָפִ֨ים וְהַמֵּא֜וֹת וְלַשֹּֽׁפְטִ֗ים וּלְכֹ֛ל נָשִׂ֥יא לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·mōh way·yō·mer lə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl lə·śā·rê hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·ham·mê·’ō·wṯ wə·laš·šō·p̄ə·ṭîm ū·lə·ḵōl nā·śî lə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then Solomon spoke to all Israel to the commanders of thousands and of hundreds to the judges and to every leader in all Israel the heads of the families

verses.original: שְׁלֹמֹה֙ וְכָל־ הַקָּהָ֣ל עִמּ֔וֹ וַיֵּלְכ֗וּ לַבָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּגִבְע֑וֹן כִּי־ הָיָ֗ה שָׁ֣ם הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֥ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֖ה עָשָׂ֛ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·mōh wə·ḵāl haq·qā·hāl ‘im·mōw way·yê·lə·ḵū lab·bā·māh ’ă·šer bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn kî- hā·yāh šām hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ’ă·šer mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ- Yah·weh ‘ā·śāh bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: And Solomon and the whole assembly - went to the high place - at Gibeon because it was the location of God’s Tent of Meeting which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness

verses.original: אֲבָ֗ל דָוִיד֙ מִקִּרְיַ֣ת הֶעֱלָ֤ה אֲר֤וֹן הָאֱלֹהִים֙ יְעָרִ֔ים דָּוִ֑יד בַּֽהֵכִ֥ין ל֖וֹ כִּ֧י נָֽטָה־ אֹ֖הֶל ל֛וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇāl ḏā·wîḏ miq·qir·yaṯ he·‘ĕ·lāh ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm yə·‘ā·rîm dā·wîḏ ba·hê·ḵîn lōw kî nā·ṭāh- ’ō·hel lōw bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Now David had brought the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim to the place he had prepared for it because he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem

verses.original: הַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת וּמִזְבַּ֣ח אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ בְּצַלְאֵל֙ בֶּן־ אוּרִ֣י בֶן־ ח֔וּר שָׂ֕ם לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה וְהַקָּהָֽל׃ וַיִּדְרְשֵׁ֥הוּ
verses.transliteration: han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·miz·baḥ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh bə·ṣal·’êl ben- ’ū·rî ḇen- ḥūr śām lip̄·nê miš·kan Yah·weh šə·lō·mōh wə·haq·qā·hāl way·yiḏ·rə·šê·hū
verses.literal: But the bronze altar - made by Bezalel son of Uri the son of Hur was [in Gibeon] before the tabernacle of the LORD So Solomon and the assembly inquired of Him there

verses.original: שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה וַיַּעַל֩ שָׁ֜ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ מִזְבַּ֤ח לְאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד עָלָ֛יו וַיַּ֧עַל אָֽלֶף׃ עֹל֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·mōh way·ya·‘al šām lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ă·šer ‘al- han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ miz·baḥ lə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ‘ā·lāw way·ya·‘al ’ā·lep̄ ‘ō·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Solomon offered sacrifices there before the LORD - on the bronze altar at the Tent of Meeting [where] he offered a thousand burnt offerings

verses.original: הַה֔וּא בַּלַּ֣יְלָה אֱלֹהִ֖ים נִרְאָ֥ה לִשְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ שְׁאַ֖ל מָ֥ה אֶתֶּן־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bal·lay·lāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm nir·’āh liš·lō·mōh way·yō·mer lōw šə·’al māh ’et·ten- lāḵ
verses.literal: That night God appeared to Solomon and said - Ask - [and] I will give it to you

verses.original: שְׁלֹמֹה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים אַתָּ֗ה עָשִׂ֛יתָ גָּד֑וֹל חֶ֣סֶד עִם־ אָבִ֖י דָּוִ֥יד וְהִמְלַכְתַּ֖נִי תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·mōh way·yō·mer lê·lō·hîm ’at·tāh ‘ā·śî·ṯā gā·ḏō·wl ḥe·seḏ ‘im- ’ā·ḇî dā·wîḏ wə·him·laḵ·ta·nî taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: Solomon replied to God You have shown much loving devotion to my father David and You have made me king in his place

verses.original: עַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים דְּבָ֣רְךָ֔ עִ֖ם אָבִ֑י דָּוִ֣יד יֵֽאָמֵן֙ כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ הִמְלַכְתַּ֔נִי עַל־ עַ֕ם רַ֖ב כַּעֲפַ֥ר הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm də·ḇā·rə·ḵā ‘im ’ā·ḇî dā·wîḏ yê·’ā·mên kî ’at·tāh him·laḵ·ta·nî ‘al- ‘am raḇ ka·‘ă·p̄ar hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Now O LORD God let Your promise to my father David be fulfilled For You have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה תֶּן־ לִ֔י חָכְמָ֤ה וּמַדָּע֙ וְאֵֽצְאָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י וְאָב֑וֹאָה הַזֶּ֖ה הָֽעָם־ כִּֽי־ מִ֣י יִשְׁפֹּ֔ט אֶת־ הַזֶּ֖ה הַגָּדֽוֹל׃ס עַמְּךָ֥
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh ten- lî ḥāḵ·māh ū·mad·dā‘ wə·’ê·ṣə·’āh lip̄·nê wə·’ā·ḇō·w·’āh haz·zeh hā·‘ām- kî- mî yiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- haz·zeh hag·gā·ḏō·wl ‘am·mə·ḵā
verses.literal: Now grant me wisdom and knowledge so that I may lead . . . . . . this people For who is able to govern - this great people of Yours

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים׀ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר־ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֡ה יַ֣עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ זֹ֜את הָיְתָ֨ה עִם־ לְבָבֶ֗ךָ וְלֹֽא־ שָׁ֠אַלְתָּ עֹ֣שֶׁר נְכָסִ֤ים וְכָבוֹד֙ וְאֵת֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׂנְאֶ֔יךָ לֹ֣א וְגַם־ שָׁאָ֑לְתָּ רַבִּ֖ים יָמִ֥ים וַתִּֽשְׁאַל־ לְךָ֙ חָכְמָ֣ה וּמַדָּ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּשְׁפּוֹט֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י עָלָֽיו׃ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִמְלַכְתִּ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·mer- liš·lō·mōh ya·‘an ’ă·šer zōṯ hā·yə·ṯāh ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā wə·lō·šā- šā·ʾal·tā ‘ō·šer nə·ḵā·sîm wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ wə·’êṯ ne·p̄eš śō·nə·’e·ḵā lō wə·ḡam- šā·’ā·lə·tā rab·bîm yā·mîm wat·tiš·’al- lə·ḵā ḥāḵ·māh ū·mad·dā‘ ’ă·šer tiš·pō·wṭ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer him·laḵ·tî·ḵā
verses.literal: God said to Solomon Since - this was in your heart instead of requesting riches or wealth or honor [for yourself] or death for your enemies and since you have not even requested long life but have asked for wisdom and knowledge - to govern - My people over whom I have made you king

verses.original: הַֽחָכְמָ֥ה וְהַמַּדָּ֖ע נָת֣וּן לָ֑ךְ אֶתֶּן־ לָ֔ךְ וְעֹ֨שֶׁר וּנְכָסִ֤ים וְכָבוֹד֙ לֹא־ כֵ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ הָ֣יָה לַמְּלָכִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְפָנֶ֔יךָ יִֽהְיֶה־ כֵּֽן׃ לֹ֥א וְאַחֲרֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥā·ḵə·māh wə·ham·mad·dā‘ nā·ṯūn lāḵ ’et·ten- lāḵ wə·‘ō·šer ū·nə·ḵā·sîm wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ lō- ḵên ’ă·šer hā·yāh lam·mə·lā·ḵîm ’ă·šer lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā yih·yeh- kên lō wə·’a·ḥă·re·ḵā
verses.literal: therefore wisdom and knowledge have been granted to you And I will also give you riches and wealth and honor unlike . . . anything - given to the kings - before you [or] . . . . . . after you

verses.original: שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה וַיָּבֹ֨א יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לַבָּמָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־ בְּגִבְעוֹן֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·mōh way·yā·ḇō yə·rū·šā·lim lab·bā·māh ’ă·šer- bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn mil·lip̄·nê ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ way·yim·lōḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Solomon went to Jerusalem from the high place - in Gibeon from before the Tent of Meeting and he reigned over Israel

verses.original: שְׁלֹמֹה֮ וַיֶּאֱסֹ֣ף רֶ֣כֶב וּפָרָשִׁים֒ וַֽיְהִי־ ל֗וֹ אֶ֤לֶף וְאַרְבַּע־ מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֔כֶב וּשְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וַיַּנִּיחֵם֙ הָרֶ֔כֶב בְּעָרֵ֣י וְעִם־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·mōh way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ re·ḵeḇ ū·p̄ā·rā·šîm way·hî- lōw ’e·lep̄ wə·’ar·ba‘- mê·’ō·wṯ re·ḵeḇ ū·šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār ’e·lep̄ pā·rā·šîm way·yan·nî·ḥêm hā·re·ḵeḇ bə·‘ā·rê wə·‘im- ham·me·leḵ bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Solomon accumulated - - - - 1,400 . . . . . . chariots and 12,000 . . . . . . horses which he stationed in the chariot cities and also with [him] in Jerusalem

verses.original: הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הַכֶּ֧סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָ֛ב בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם כָּאֲבָנִ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת נָתַ֛ן הָאֲרָזִ֗ים לָרֹֽב׃ כַּשִּׁקְמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- way·yit·tên hak·ke·sep̄ wə·’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ bî·rū·šā·lim kā·’ă·ḇā·nîm wə·’êṯ nā·ṯan hā·’ă·rā·zîm lā·rōḇ kaš·šiq·mîm ’ă·šer- baš·šə·p̄ê·lāh
verses.literal: The king - made silver - and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones and - cedar as abundant as sycamore - in the foothills

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִשְׁלֹמֹ֖ה הַסּוּסִ֛ים וּמוֹצָ֧א מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וּמִקְוֵ֕א הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ סֹחֲרֵ֣י יִקְח֖וּ בִּמְחִֽיר׃ מִקְוֵ֥א
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer liš·lō·mōh has·sū·sîm ū·mō·w·ṣā mim·miṣ·rā·yim ū·miq·wê ham·me·leḵ sō·ḥă·rê yiq·ḥū bim·ḥîr miq·wê
verses.literal: Solomon’s . . . horses were imported from Egypt and Kue the royal merchants purchased them . . . from Kue

verses.original: מֶרְכָּבָה֙ וַֽ֠יַּעֲלוּ וַיּוֹצִ֨יאוּ מִמִּצְרַ֤יִם בְּשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת כֶּ֔סֶף וְס֖וּס וּמֵאָ֑ה בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וְ֠כֵן בְּיָדָ֥ם יוֹצִֽיאוּ׃ לְכָל־ מַלְכֵ֧י הַֽחִתִּ֛ים וּמַלְכֵ֥י אֲרָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: mer·kā·ḇāh way·ya·‘ă·lū way·yō·w·ṣî·’ū mim·miṣ·ra·yim bə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ ke·sep̄ wə·sūs ū·mê·’āh ba·ḥă·miš·šîm wə·ḵên bə·yā·ḏām yō·w·ṣî·’ū lə·ḵāl mal·ḵê ha·ḥit·tîm ū·mal·ḵê ’ă·rām
verses.literal: A chariot could be imported . . . from Egypt for six hundred [shekels] of silver and a horse for a hundred and fifty Likewise [they] exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Aram
